summary: BGIN Blockchain Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 25, 2026, reporting unaudited interim financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes condensed consolidated balance sheets, statements of operations and cash flows as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation transaction is disclosed: no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or management change. Revenue fell to $7.38 million from $47.66 million, with a gross loss of $9.87 million and negative operating cash flow indicators. Balance sheet shows total assets of $68.03 million versus liabilities of $38.86 million.
